content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-409. - Civil penalties; continuing non-compliance.
content.summary:
(a)
Civil Penalties.
Property owners who do not comply with
section 102-408
shall be assessed a civil penalty of $1,000.00. An additional $1,000.00 civil penalty
               shall be assessed for each subsequent year of continued non-compliance in accordance
               with
section 102-408
.

faqs.a:
(a)
Civil Penalties.
Property owners who do not comply with
section 102-408
shall be assessed a civil penalty of $1,000.00. An additional $1,000.00 civil penalty
               shall be assessed for each subsequent year of continued non-compliance in accordance
               with
section 102-408
.
(b)
If at any time after a violation notice has been issued, a property owner replaces
               LSL in compliance with this article and the engineering standards, and provides documentation
               sufficient to establish the same, the director is authorized to forgive the civil
               penalty assessment for the year that the documentation is submitted. Civil penalties
               for previous years, as well as liens for those amounts, shall remain in place.
(
Ord. No. 4869
, § 1, 3-4-2024)
